map.PTA = 500、1000、2000Hz 气导阈值的平均值。气骨导差(ABG): PTA is the mean of the air conduction thresholds at 500, 1000 and 2000 Hz. The air-bone gap (ABG) = PTA (air conduction) − PTA (bone conduction). An ABG above 10 dB indicates a conductive component, and a bone conduction threshold above 25 dB a sensorineural component.
